canonical.title: IT conferences & tech events within 30 km of Slagmolen (2026)

parent.title: Weekend at Slagmolen: lodging, activities and tech events around a Michelin watermill

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Slagmolen
siblings.summary: Book one of Slagmolen's four on-site villa rooms first; Bed and Beyond is the only true walking-distance fallback at 1.6 km. Everything else is taxi-only.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Slagmolen
siblings.summary: Eight character stays around Slagmolen (Opglabbeek, 2 star), from the four luxury rooms above the watermill to a 1736 chaplain's-residence inn, a designer B&B, a castle hotel and woodland cabins.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Slagmolen
siblings.summary: Hoge Kempen gateways, the three Limburg cycle-through-X bridges, Bokrijk & C-Mine, Plopsa Hasselt, Maasmechelen Village, Elaisa spa.
